svg.title: 10 · Living messages: one per thing, edited in place
svg.text: 10 · Living messages: one per thing, edited in place
Use case: anyone glancing at # now-and-next or # food knows the state of the event without scrolling; the bot edits its own pinned messages from events (#123).
A · # now-and-next: the pinned board at three moments
Now · Doors open · café and hall
Edited 19:02 · the run of show, live
Now · Match 3 · Demo Arena · on the stage
Food · order 3 open until 20:45 · order 2 on the way
Edited 20:14 · the run of show, live
Now · Quiet hours in the hall until 08:00
Edited 23:30 · the run of show, live
Edited on agenda.* and pizza.* events, at most once a minute per channel (Discord's edit
limits); after a restart the bot finds its pinned message again by its stored id.
B · # food: order 2 is one message from open to done
Open until 20:08 · 3 pizzas · held by Player Two
It's here · pick up at the café counter
No names in the channel: counts and the holder only (step 5 D9). People with a pizza get
“It's here” by Notify, as push or Discord DM, as they chose; the channel post never pings them.
C · On a phone: the same messages in Discord's phone layout, 390 px

g.text: Edited 20:14 · the run of show, live

svg.text: C1 · # now-and-next: the board, pinned on top

g.text: Is there still time for one more?
Order 3 is open, join that one.

svg.text: C2 · # food: one message per order
· The board is one message, pinned, edited
in place: the phone shows it on top and in
· Each order is one message from open to
here; its dots fill as it moves on.
· Embeds fit 390 px: a title, one fact per
line, one button. The channel post names
the holder only and pings nobody.
